name: Extra Paragraph Types (EPT): Tabs
description: Adds a Tabs paragraph type built on the jQuery UI Tabs plugin; each tab can hold rich text, a page reference, a block, or an embedded view.
project_description: Extra Paragraph Types: Tabs adds a ready-made Tabs paragraph type. Each tab item can hold formatted text, a referenced page (node), a placed block, or an embedded view, chosen per tab via a content-type selector. The tab set is rendered client-side with the jQuery UI Tabs plugin and ships six visual style presets (default, without header background, minimalist tabs, tabs like buttons, vertical tabs, vertical tabs rotated) plus jQuery UI options (active panel index, collapsible, all-closed, disable, heightStyle). Like every EPT paragraph type it extends EPT Core's shared settings widget, which adds Design options (margins/padding/borders, background color/image/video, container width, edge-to-edge) and Title options. Part of the Extra Paragraph Types (EPT) family alongside EPT Accordion, EPT Carousel, EPT Columns, EPT Text, EPT Tiles and others.
